# talosdigitaltechnologies.github.io

The public pages for Orna, by Talos Digital Technologies LLC: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, support, and `app-ads.txt`.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are written by `node scripts/build-legal-site.mjs` in the Orna app's repository, from the same legal text the app shows. To change a page, change the text in the app and run the script again.
